text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan

(Pindaan) 2015.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Februari 2015.

Pindaan Jadual

2. Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989], yang disebut

"Perintah ibu" dalam Perintah ini, dipinda dalam Jadual dengan menggantikan

butiran 16 dengan butiran yang berikut:

"16. Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya KL-Kuala Selangor yang

bermula dari―

(a) kilometer 0.00 di koordinat U366573.829, T375376.712 Grid

Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM2000) hingga

kilometer 3.125 di koordinat U364281.685, T376693.729 Grid

RSO Geosentrik (GDM2000) arah timur dan arah barat;

(b) kilometer 4.325 di koordinat U364132.084, T377887.279 Grid

RSO Geosentrik (GDM2000) hingga kilometer 19.00 di koordinat

U361830.638, T391979.334 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM2000) arah

timur;

(c) kilometer 20.20 di koordinat U362053.731, T393160.536 Grid

RSO Geosentrik (GDM2000) hingga kilometer 26.125 di koordinat

U363680.336, T397741.281 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM2000) arah

timur;

(d) kilometer 26.125 di koordinat U363680.336, T397741.281 Grid

RSO Geosentrik (GDM2000) hingga kilometer 14.10 di koordinat

U362171.406, T387107.323 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM2000) arah

barat; dan

(e) kilometer 12.90 di koordinat U362054.928, T385912.628 Grid

RSO Geosentrik (GDM2000) hingga kilometer 4.325 di koordinat

U364132.084, T377887.279 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM2000) arah

barat."

Peta

3. Jalan dengan had laju yang dinyatakan dalam butiran 16 Perintah ibu

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

[Perenggan 3]

PETA LEBUH RAYA KL-KUALA SELANGOR

Dibuat 21 Januari 2015

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/28; PN(PU2)460/LXXVII]

DATO' SRI LIOW TIONG LAI

Menteri Pengangkutan

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

NATIONAL SPEED LIMIT (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(1) of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the National Speed Limit (Amendment)

Order 2015.

1. (2) This Order comes into operation on 1 February 2015.

Amendment of Schedule

2. The National Speed Limit Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989], which is referred to as

the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in the Schedule by substituting for item

16 the following item:

"16. The part of the road known as the KL-Kuala Selangor Expressway

commencing from―

(a) kilometre 0.00 at coordinates N366573.829, E375376.712

Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric (GDM2000) Grid

until kilometre 3.125 at coordinates N364281.685, E376693.729

RSO Geocentric (GDM2000) Grid east bound and west bound;

(b) kilometre 4.325 at coordinates N364132.084, E377887.279 RSO

Geocentric (GDM2000) Grid until kilometre 19.00 at coordinates

N361830.638, E391979.334 RSO Geocentric (GDM2000) Grid east

bound;

(c) kilometre 20.20 at coordinates N362053.731, E393160.536 RSO

Geocentric (GDM2000) Grid until kilometre 26.125 at coordinates

N363680.336, E397741.281 RSO Geocentric (GDM2000) Grid east

bound;

(d) kilometre 26.125 at coordinates N363680.336, E397741.281 RSO

Geocentric (GDM2000) Grid until kilometre 14.10 at coordinates

N362171.406, E387107.323 RSO Geocentric [GDM2000] Grid west

bound; and

(e) kilometre 12.90 at coordinates N362054.928, E385912.628 RSO

Geocentric (GDM2000) Grid until kilometre 4.325 at coordinates

N364132.084, E377887.279 RSO Geocentric (GDM2000) Grid west

bound."

Map

3. The road with the speed limit as specified in item 16 of the principal Order is

shown on the map in the Schedule.
